title: Intestinal Microsporidiosis in French Heart Transplant Recipients (CARMIC)
official: Intestinal Microsporidiosis in French Heart Transplant Recipients
summary: The investigators propose to carry out a national retrospective study to collect epidemiological, biological, clinical and therapeutic data on microsporidiosis among heart transplant patients.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* heart transplant patients diagnosed with intestinal microsporidiosis
* diagnosis made before December 31, 2024 in France (metropolitan France and overseas territories)

Exclusion Criteria:

-patient opposition
